assets.prompt: Create one wide photographic contact sheet for an adult A1 English coursebook, four equal-width rectangular photographs arranged in ONE horizontal row, narrow clean white gutters, 4:1 overall aspect ratio. Panel 2: a different adult man trying on a plain dark red jacket in front of a full-length shop mirror; adjusting the lapels, jacket naturally fitted. Panel 3: a smiling young adult woman at home taking possession of a new roomy blue fabric tote, holding the bag next to a clearly empty delivery box on the table; pleased with her purchase, keeping the bag. Panel 4: an adult man at a parcel-service counter passing a closed plain brown parcel to a clerk across the counter; return transaction, both people's hands complete and visible. Crop to medium shots so the action is clear at textbook size. Warm realistic colors, no stylized graphics.
